title: Banded Cyclic QFT Two-Call Schedules: Analytical Inner-Digit Elimination and O(M 3^b) Transfer-Matrix Contraction

scope.inner_digit_elimination: Analytically summing over each intermediate digit v_{M-1-k} in {0,1,2} reduces the 3^(2M)-path 2-call banded cyclic QFT amplitude to a product of M local window factors L_k^(b)(w_k,...,w_{min(M-1,k+b-1)})
scope.backward_transfer_matrix_dp: Sweeping k from M-1 down to 0 eliminates w_k at step k over a boundary state S_k of size 3^min(b-1, M-1-k), computing exact Born probabilities in sum_{k=0}^{M-1} 3^min(b, M-k) <= M*3^b window evaluations
scope.bandwidth_scaling_threshold: Constant or O(log M) twiddle bandwidth b is classically contractible in poly(M) time; only b = omega(log M) escapes polynomial transfer-matrix contraction
